select
(select count(distinct d.device_id,d.tenant_id) from iot_device d where d.tenant_id = 1 ) as deviceCount,
(select count(distinct d.device_id,d.tenant_id) from iot_device d
d.status=3 and d.tenant_id = 1
) as deviceOnlineCount,
( select count(product_id) from iot_product ) as productCount,
(select count(distinct alert_log_id) from iot_alert_log l left join iot_device d on l.serial_number=d.serial_number where d.tenant_id = 1 ) as alertCount

select id, identify, fun_type, fun_value, message_id, device_name, serial_number, mode, user_id, result_msg, result_code, create_by, create_time, remark,show_value,model_name,reply_time from iot_function_log order by create_time DESC

SELECT device_name, serial_number, is_monitor, create_time, remark FROM iot_event_log WHERE identity IN ('online', 'offline') AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} and #{endDate} GROUP BY device_name, serial_number, is_monitor, create_time, remark ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 100
